name: Razer DeathAdder V3 Pro
notes: 94-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Razer DeathAdder V3 Pro, from a libinput record of the device on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/5f2f38e57f74ab3982fe275295f9bbd2/libinput-record. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
